main.description: Public lookup of one indexed badge definition by exact AT-URI and DID authority. The original record is preserved and only its publisher actor is hydrated. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of the badge-definition record using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or is not a badge-definition record AT-URI with a DID authority.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed badge definition exists at this exact AT-URI.

badgeDefinitionView.description: Full indexed badge-definition record view with hydrated publisher actor.
